name: Unitree H2-D Flagship
summary: H2 upper body with two 7-DOF arms on a lifting column and wheeled base, for picking and handling from floor level to 2 m in factories and warehouses.

germany.statusNote: QUADRUPED Robotics (Germany) takes orders for H2-A/H2-D with availability from 31.03.2027; no EU seller delivers yet; Unitree sells through its global sales team.

sellers.name: Unitree Robotics
sellers.note: No EU office named by Unitree; global sales contact and order form. End effectors and price: contact sales.

sellers.name: QUADRUPED Robotics (quadruped.de)
sellers.note: Page covers H2-A (upper body, from 24,100 EUR net) and H2-D stationary (Standard) or mobile (Flagship) with 13 hand options; Flagship price not shown clearly; "available from 31.03.2027".

specs.label: Height
specs.conditions: 1.2 m at minimum, 1.7 m at maximum column height

specs.label: Arm payload
specs.conditions: rated about 7 kg; peak about 15 kg

specs.label: Single-arm reach
specs.conditions: about, without hand; work height from floor to 2 m

specs.label: Battery life
specs.conditions: approx.; replaceable battery or auto charging

specs.label: Sensors
specs.value: Binocular head camera, 2 wrist cameras; base LiDAR, depth camera, collision and ultrasonic sensors

specs.label: Computing
specs.value: Intel Core i5 (platform) + Intel Core i7 (development); optional module such as Thor

capabilities.sdk: Unitree SDKs, APIs and navigation stack
notes: End effector chosen at purchase: gripper, 3-finger or 5-finger hand.
Wheeled base for flat indoor floors.
Fixed-base H2-A and manual-move H2-D Standard also exist.
